t: A safeguard set for anyone he ever wronged
a: أَوَمَا عَلِمْتِ مَا شَارَطْتُ عَلَيْهِ رَبِّي قُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ فَأَىُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لَعَنْتُهُ أَوْ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهُ لَهُ زَكَاةً وَأَجْرًا
p: Allāhumma innamā anā basharun, fa-ayyu-l-muslimīna ādhaytuhu aw sababtuhu…fa-jʿalhā lahu zakātan wa qurbah.
m: O Allah, I am only a human being. Any Muslim I have harmed or cursed, make it for him a purification and a means of nearness.
